integrity: The universal proof uses a tame double quotient of w^2=z^16+1 and the nonvanishing binomial support rule. An independent direct polynomial-computation script tests 44 primes; these finite tests are not the infinite proof. No external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the fixed degree-eight Chebyshev hyperelliptic curve over algebraically closed fields of prime characteristic p>=5. It determines Cartier-iterate ranks, geometric p-rank and a-number; it does not determine the complete Newton polygon, Ekedahl–Oort type, endomorphism ring, or zeta numerator. The superspecial congruence class was already implied by earlier maximality theorems.
title: Complete Cartier rank profiles for the genus-three Chebyshev octic
